definitive_technical_blocker_conclusion.justification: Abaqus native stress recovery error (MISESERI) is evaluated via *ERROR ESTIMATE which operates exclusively on standard continuum elements. In coupled phase-field simulations (f42_mixed_uel.for), UEL elements do not evaluate continuum stress recovery, leaving MISESERI identically 0.0 in forward solver runs. No intermediate continuum solve representing an authentic post-initiation cracked state exists in pre-existing Case 2 artifacts. Under the research priority lock, fabricating an indicator or relabeling damage sizing as MISESERI is strictly disqualified. The prefracture pre-analysis donor (PK_HOLE_METHOD_A_PREANALYSIS.odb) is the sole authentic native donor for Case 2 Method A, and its regional resolution profile is physically causal and non-hindsight.
